name: DeepLesion: Large-Scale NIH Clinical CT Lesion Detection Dataset
description: DeepLesion is a massive multi-category radiological benchmark created by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) Clinical Center. It contains 32,735 clinically annotated lesion bounding boxes identified in 32,120 axial CT slices across 10,594 studies from 4,427 unique patients. It spans diverse lesion types including lung nodules, liver lesions, lymphadenopathy, and bone lesions marked by board-certified radiologists.
